about: The mutant ledger of cmd/ergo: edits of the command line that some cmd/ergo test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./cmd/ergo (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded by binsize BS4.

mutants.name: bs4-default-unstripped
